ruleDefinitions.name: Dumping of Sensitive Hives Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" in order to dump sensitive registry hives. This includes SAM, SYSTEM and SECURITY hives.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ save\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ export\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ˢave\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ eˣport\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*hklm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hk˪m.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hkey\\_local\\_machine.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hkey\\_˪ocal\\_machine.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hkey\\_loca˪\\_machine.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hkey\\_˪oca˪\\_machine.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\system.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\sam.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\security.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ˢystem.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\syˢtem.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ˢyˢtem.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ˢam.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ˢecurity.*")))
